verdict.rationale: Unit exposes webhook events (unit-docs-25) that let external systems react to account/transaction events, and mentions automating lending/repayment flows (unit-docs-15), but there is no documented rules engine where a user can declaratively define conditional triggers and actions inside Unit itself. missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine (conditions + actions), documentation of trigger configuration UI or API beyond webhooks, and examples of automated actions Unit executes on its own.
